commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Siebe Van Der Heyden (Mallorca) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+8' Unsportsmanlike conduct. Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) is shown a red card off the pitch!

90+7' What a big chance! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.

90+6' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Predrag Rajkovic makes a comfortable save.

90+5' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
90+1' Javier Aguirre is stunned as referee Alejandro Ruiz shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

88' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Marc-Andre ter Stegen.
87' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is penalised for a foul. Alejandro Ruiz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Rodriguez departs the field of play to be replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
85' Here is a change. Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud is going off and Javier Aguirre gives the last tactical orders to Siebe Van Der Heyden (Mallorca).
84' The referee Alejandro Ruiz awards Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) a yellow card.
82' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by Marc-Andre ter Stegen.
80' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

80' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner.

79' What a great touch by Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Mallorca.
78' Xavi has decided to substitute Inigo Martinez and he is replaced by Jules Kounde (Barcelona).
75' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Raphinha tees up Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Predrag Rajkovic.
72' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Predrag Rajkovic, who smothers the ball.
68' NO PENALTY! Referee Alejandro Ruiz has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Barcelona players are incensed.
66' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Barcelona using VAR. Let's see what happens.
66' Jose Copete (Mallorca) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Barcelona.
64' Here comes a substitution. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Joao Felix.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oriol Romeu trots off the pitch and is replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
62' Javier Aguirre has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cyle Larin (Mallorca) replacing Antonio Sanchez.
62' The game has come to an end for Abdon Prats. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
61' Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) gets booked for the first time in this match.
61' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
59' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 30:70.

58' Xavi prepares a substitution. Ferran Torres is replaced by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
57' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
55' Joao Felix (Barcelona) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
52' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.

45+8' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

45+7' The ball is cleared after Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+7' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Alejandro Ruiz who sees an offensive foul.
45+3' 2 - 1 GOAL! Vedat Muriqi meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Abdon Prats (Mallorca) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:1.
45+3' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.

45+2' Predrag Rajkovic was forced into action to thwart Joao Felix (Barcelona). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.

45+1' The opposition can't get near Raphinha (Barcelona), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just over the bar at the last second. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.

38' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) latches onto the free kick from Daniel Rodriguez, but heads just over the bar from close range. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.

35' Javier Aguirre is forced to make a change. Pablo Maffeo is unable to continue due to injury, Jaume Costa (Mallorca) comes on.
34' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) trips an opposition player and Alejandro Ruiz signals a foul.
29' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Raphinha (Barcelona).

26' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
25' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
25' Barcelona try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
24' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. A free kick to Barcelona.
22' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.

20' Raphinha (Barcelona) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom right corner, but Predrag Rajkovic made a superb athletic save to deny him.
19' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen is equal to it and makes an easy save.
17' A clumsy foul by Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle.
16' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner but it's cleared.
13' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
13' Referee Alejandro Ruiz sees the trip by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Barcelona will take a free kick near the side line.
11' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' 1 - 0 Gooal! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Antonio Sanchez. He makes it 1:0.
6' Raphinha (Barcelona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
